sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that defeat, Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games and an impressive recent record of one loss in their last five outings, so they should be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have won just once all season and are on a poor run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face an away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, with Stafford themselves coming off a loss and looking to stay in the title hunt. AFC Bridgnorth and Wolverhampton Casuals, both on 19 points, clash with different opponents — Bridgnorth host struggling Eccleshall (who have recovered with a recent win) while Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, unbeaten in their last three, visit Foley Meir in a solid mid-table matchup. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two sides with mixed recent form. Barnton travel to Shawbury United, who are in alarming form with five consecutive losses. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the bottom, host Telford Town in a basement-area battle between two struggling sides. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in another encounter between lower-table teams, while Widnes Town, pointless in recent games, face a tough away test at high-flying Brereton Social. The midweek fixture sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening.
